# Ériu Sourcing

> Irish-run China sourcing agent. Ériu Sourcing helps Irish and UK businesses buy factory-direct from China: supplier verification, price negotiation, pre-shipment quality control, CE compliance and freight to Ireland. Founded by Noel Murphy, based in China since 2008, with teams in Shenzhen (Guangdong) and Zhengzhou (Henan). Irish address: Springfield, Clonlara, Co. Clare. The Ériu Modular Homes division supplies CE-marked expandable steel-frame homes for Irish back gardens.

Key facts:
- Service area: Ireland and the United Kingdom.
- China bases: Shenzhen (electronics, consumer goods, finishing materials) and Zhengzhou, Henan (steel, modular buildings, machinery, construction materials).
- Core services: factory identification and vetting, sampling, pre-shipment inspection, CE compliance checks, freight coordination, landed-cost quoting.
- Modular homes: four expandable models (20ft, 30ft, 40ft, 20FT700). Factory pricing runs from €8,995 FOB for a structural shell to €65,000 FOB for a premium furnished unit, before freight, VAT and Irish site works. A basic livable 20ft unit starts from about €25,000 delivered. The 20ft Expandable (about 34 m² internal) is the model that fits Ireland's 32–45 m² Class 3A back-garden exemption (S.I. No. 340 of 2026, in force since 27 July 2026).
- Contact: https://eriusourcing.com/contact/ · +353 87 118 7806 (phone and WhatsApp)

- [Why Zhengzhou and Henan](https://eriusourcing.com/zhengzhou/): Sourcing from inland China, costs versus the coast, logistics and the manufacturing base

## Modular homes (Ireland)

- [Ériu Modular Homes](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/): Expandable steel-frame homes for Irish back gardens
- [Back-garden homes and Class 3A](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/back-garden-homes-ireland/): The 32–45 m² planning exemption, its conditions, the rental and tax position, planning versus building regulations
- [Auxiliary dwelling definition](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/auxiliary-dwelling-ireland/): Every Class 3A condition, rental tax, LPT, insurance and mortgage points
- [Building regulations](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/building-regulations-ireland/): Why planning-exempt homes still need full Building Regulations compliance, a Commencement Notice and an NZEB BER
- [Models](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/models/): 20ft, 30ft, 40ft and 20FT700 specifications and floor plans
- [Cost](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/cost/): FOB price tiers and the full installed-cost stack
- [Rental income](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/rental-income-garden-home-ireland/): Long-term letting a garden home, the RTB position and after-tax numbers
- [A home for adult children](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/home-for-adult-children-ireland/)
- [Downsizing and granny flats](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/downsizing-granny-flat-ireland/)
- [Factory visits](https://eriusourcing.com/modular-homes/factory-visits/): Three-day factory visit programme in Zhengzhou and Shenzhen
